metric_definitions.macro_f1: Mean F1 across negative, neutral, positive; higher is better.
metric_definitions.MAE: Mean absolute close-price error in source units; lower is better.
metric_definitions.RMSE: Root mean square close-price error; lower is better.
metric_definitions.directional_accuracy: Three-way down/flat/up relative to previous observed close.
metric_definitions.confidence: Maximum softmax score; not a guarantee and not calibrated by default.
